Background
PoE(Power over Ethernet) helps users transmit data and power on one single network cable, which greatly facilitates installation and enriches Ethernet applications.
Some special functions in a PoE device such as PoE watchdog, PoE distance extension and PoE management also help reduce manual intervention and make the entire system smarter.
However, in short-distance cabling and network systems, the application scenarios are very complex, below are some examples
12V/24V power input for PD
Long distance of PD and PSE(more than 100-meter)
Temporarily separate data and power
Too many Non-PoE IP devices in existing project
Higher power required after project upgrading
Replacement due to power surges and brownouts
Under this background, Saga Telecom presents an ample quantity of indoor and outdoor application-based PoE devices covering
PoE Splitter
PoE Repeater/Extender
PoE Injector/Midspan
Popular IEEE 802.3af, IEEE 802.3at, IEEE 802.3bt standards are carried, those affordable units are suitable different Ethernet-defined projects and eliminate complex installation.
Meanwhile we have
Power booster/step-up and passive PoE models
Commercial and industrial 802.3bt switches
Its ideal to include all those PoE-related devices to build a PoE package for your network systems.
Application
Last-mile Ethernet transmission solution
Small area PoE-related cabling
12V/24V/48V powered network system
Name Rule
ST=Saga Telecom
C=Commercial grade
I=Industrial grade
PI=PoE Injector
PS=PoE Splitter
PE=PoE Extender
G=Gigabit
DG=2.5 Gigabit
XG=10 Gigabit
30W/60W/90W=Budget
12V/24V/48V=Voltage
This is ONLY about some general rules about our nomenclature.
There will be some special naming in each category to indicate the features.
It is advised to read specific product description for more information.

FAQ
Leadtime
Production time is usually 5~7 working days for standard(non-customized) models (no more than 50pcs).
Shipping time is usually 4~7 days by air
In total, it takes 10~15 days for a client to receive the order.
Shipment
We will send the goods by air(DHL, UPS or FEDEX) or by sea(for bulk order)
It is fine to ship purchased items via customer’s shipping account or forwarder.
MOQ
1 Pc/Pair(It is NOT free, Saga Telecom do NOT do FREE SAMPLES)
It is fine to have sample testing before bulk order, but 1 Pc/Pair is ONLY about sample testing.
When testing proves fine, MOQ is 20pcs(discussion is required if it is about smaller quantity).
Warranty
1 year for commercial models(STC series) and 3 years for industrial models(STI series)
Please kindly refer to the “Warranty Policy” for more information.
Technical assistance is always available
Payment
T/T transfer and PayPal, FULL AMOUNT BEFORE SHIPMENT.
It is fine to pay 50% first and another 50% before shipment for bulk order.
It is fine to be paid via customer’s forwarder(this is usually about RMB payment).
Transaction cost
It is standard charge 25usd for EACH T/T transfer whatever the invoice value is.
It is 5usd for every 100usd to PayPal a/c, this ratio is standard charge by PayPal
RMA
Please contact us ASAP once there is any problem(package or usage)with the supplied products.
For every 100pcs, there will be 2 extra free units(2% RMA) against immediate warranty coverage.
This rule stands for all Saga Telecom models and even there is not an after-sales issue.
If it is about missing/faulty parts in the packing box.
Please simply use the extra units for the replacement and let us know this problem(we will improve).
If it is about usage problem.
Saga Telecom will provide technical support and send new units when necessary.
OEM
Supported, but discussion is required if it is about complex requirements.
Below are usual OEM services available.
Show client’s logo/model on the device/label/management interface...
Use client’s packing box
Design client’s product PVC sticker
Customize some parts of a model like rear panel/power input terminal block...
Please know that there might be extra cost for OEM services.
